classification_definitions.supported: The claim stays within the observable and is backed by authority sufficient for that exact inference.
classification_definitions.accurately_limited: The claim expressly limits itself to the observable or correctly states an authority or inference boundary.
classification_definitions.unsupported_provider_inference: The claim presents or implies an Anthropic production detection or removal result without authority for Anthropic's deployed configuration and detector.
classification_definitions.overstated_authorship_inference: The claim upgrades watermark or provider-involvement evidence into authorship, ownership, or responsibility.
classification_definitions.unresolved: The captured material is too ambiguous or incomplete to support a stronger classification.
classification_definitions.mechanism_demo_not_provider_detector: The claim accurately demonstrates a public watermark mechanism or configuration and does not establish an Anthropic production result.

authority_class_definitions.none: No verifier, implementation, or reproducible observation supporting the inference is exposed in the captured source.
authority_class_definitions.public_observation: A publicly reproducible observation such as Unicode code-point inspection, without provider-watermark authority.
authority_class_definitions.public_reference: A public mechanism specification or implementation evaluated under its own disclosed configuration.
authority_class_definitions.provider_gated: Provider-specific key, configuration, detector, or API authority not publicly available in the captured sources.
authority_class_definitions.public_verification: A publicly available verifier with authority for the exact deployed mechanism and configuration being claimed.

claims.claim_text: Find hidden characters that AI detection systems use to identify content produced by Claude, and other AI tools.
claims.observable: The captured page's client-side code checks a fixed list of Unicode code points and reports or removes matches.
claims.rationale: Unicode membership is reproducible, but Anthropic states that its text watermark adds no hidden characters and detection uses Anthropic's key. The Unicode result cannot be upgraded to an Anthropic production-watermark result.
limitations: The audit inspected the captured page copy and client-side code but did not submit text to the live service.
The classification applies to this quoted provider-identification claim, not to the page's separate Unicode-cleaning capability.

claims.claim_text: Detect and remove supported hidden Unicode characters from Claude text
claims.observable: The quoted subtitle limits the operation to supported hidden Unicode characters in submitted text.
claims.rationale: The exact claim is about Unicode observation and cleanup, not an authoritative Anthropic statistical-watermark decision.
limitations: The page title uses watermark remover and detector language; this record classifies only the narrower quoted subtitle.
The audit did not submit text to the live service or assess transformation correctness.

claims.claim_text: allowing AI checkers to detect copy generated by Claude with 100% accuracy.
claims.observable: The captured article states a performance number but exposes no evaluated detector, dataset, threshold, or result for that number.
claims.rationale: Anthropic describes probabilistic likelihood, weaker detection on small or constrained samples, a provider key, and a detection API whose implementation details are still being worked out. The captured page does not support universal 100% accuracy.
limitations: No claim is made about evaluations or private integrations not disclosed on the captured page.
The article also contains narrower caveats; this classification applies only to the quoted accuracy claim.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic has not yet published its complete detection specification
claims.observable: The article distinguishes Unicode cleanup and model-assisted rewriting from verification against Anthropic's detector.
claims.rationale: The limitation matches Anthropic's current statement that a detection API will be offered soon and implementation details are still being worked out.
limitations: This is a statement about the current public specification, not a claim that public verification is impossible in general.
Authorized non-public access, if any, is outside the captured public record.

claims.claim_text: SynthID Text has been open sourced to make watermarking for text generation available to developers.
claims.observable: Official documentation describes configurable watermark application and probabilistic detection, including private, semi-private, and public verifier deployment options.
claims.rationale: The public mechanism and detector are real and usable under their own configuration. The documentation also says configurations should be stored securely and privately; it does not supply Anthropic's production key or establish Anthropic parity.
limitations: The audit did not execute or benchmark the public implementation.
This classification does not imply that watermark verification must always remain provider-gated.

claims.claim_text: This repository provides a reference implementation of the SynthID Text watermarking and detection capabilities
claims.observable: The pinned repository provides JAX reference watermarking and detection code and explicitly says it is not intended for production use.
claims.rationale: The repository supports reference-mechanism experiments under a chosen configuration. Its own scope and the missing Anthropic configuration prevent an Anthropic production inference.
limitations: The audit inspected the pinned README and did not execute the repository.
Reference status does not make the code useless; it defines the authority boundary of results produced with it.

claims.claim_text: It cannot certify that vendor detectors will fail.
claims.observable: The pinned README separates verifiable Unicode and metadata actions from best-effort statistical-text rewriting and same-configuration public harnesses.
claims.rationale: The caveat correctly refuses to upgrade public-reference or transformation evidence into a provider-detector result.
limitations: The audit classifies the quoted limitation, not every feature or claim in the repository.
No remover, rewrite model, or optional detector harness was executed.
